name: Load EDUKEN content
description: Verifies the migrated site loads its public EDUKEN content through the new API.
steps: Wait for the live content section to finish loading
expected: The EDUKEN CONSULT homepage is visible and the public content area does not show a server error.

name: Submit consultation request
description: Verifies a visitor can submit a consultation request through the migrated backend.
steps: Enter a name, WhatsApp number and request message
expected: A confirmation message says the consultation request was received.

name: Protected account action requires sign-in
description: Verifies protected student workspace actions do not silently expose private data to anonymous visitors.
steps: Choose the saved opportunities action while signed out
expected: The site asks the visitor to sign in instead of displaying another user's saved opportunities.

name: AI research failure is handled safely
description: Verifies the AI assistant shows a safe fallback when the research service is unavailable.
steps: If the AI service is unavailable, observe the response
expected: The user receives a clear fallback telling them to verify official sources rather than an invented answer.
